valuedWork.label: Explain how the named parts of a system produce what the diagram shows

taskFeatures.label: A figure whose parts are already labelled

performanceOutcomes.label: A causal account, not a list of the labels

valuedKnowledge.label: How parts, relations, and the whole fit together

knowledgeStructure.label: Parts and the relations among them

knowledgeTaskRelationships.label: The task asks for the relation the diagram is drawn to show

valuedWork.label: Name a plant part and say what that part does for the plant

taskFeatures.label: A labelled diagram of a flowering plant, with one part called out

representationalForms.label: A diagram and a selected name or function

performanceOutcomes.label: The correct part name, or the correct function of a named part

valuedKnowledge.label: Leaf, root, stem, and flower, and the job each one does

knowledgeStructure.label: A part and the function that belongs to it

knowledgeTaskRelationships.label: The diagram shows the part; the question asks for its name or its job

valuedWork.label: Decide whether two fractions name the same amount

taskFeatures.label: Two fractions written in lowest or non-lowest terms

representationalForms.label: A selected-response comparison of two fractions

performanceOutcomes.label: The fraction that is equivalent, or a justified choice of the larger

valuedKnowledge.label: Equivalence of fractions that simplify to the same value

knowledgeStructure.label: A single number-sense trait for fraction magnitude

knowledgeTaskRelationships.label: The item asks only about equivalence, not about operations on fractions
